posts.name: Dyce
posts.cooked:
Hi everybody.

 

I don't know if i have to make a introduction or presentation of myself before going in this forum, but i'm used to do it, so…i do it

 

 

What can i say…my nickname is Dyce, i'm French (so excuse me for my english ) and i'n new to the Multiverse.

 

I discovered the game by another forum, where one of the members says "it's one of the best superhero game he ever plays"…So, i decided to buy the Ehanced edition to try it, and i fall in love with the game…

 

Hobbies : Cinema, tv Show and reading…lots of reading (comics, books and manga).

I'm a RPG player (Player and Dungeon master)…

 

What else can I say…Happy to be now a part of the multiverse !!
